quote: In this paper, we study jargon definition modeling, which aims to acquire definitions for jargon automatically.
We design a BART-based definition generator to produce the final definition by incorporating the extracted definitional information.
Definition generation can be formulated as a conditioned sentence generation task-generating a coherent sentence to define the target jargon.
For generation, we follow Bevilacqua et al. (2020) and apply several automatic metrics, including BLEU (BL), ROUGE-L (R-L), METEOR (MT), and BERTScore (BS).
